editorial:
Sinners in Paradise is a 1938 Universal desert-island melodrama directed by James Whale and produced by Ken Goldsmith, with Madge Evans, John Boles and Bruce Cabot in the cast. A passenger plane crashes in the Pacific, and the survivors reach an isolated island and must work with its reclusive inhabitants to escape. Willie Fung plays Ping. It runs about 65 minutes and is in black and white. That makes it useful for Whale retrospectives, South Seas or castaway compilations, and B-picture programming.

Universal registered the film on May 2, 1938 (L 8007). The 28th-year renewal window ran from May 1965 to May 1966. I have not completed a full read of the 1965 or 1966 renewal volumes, so the print's renewal status is undetermined until the renewal sections and name indexes of both volumes are read in full. The layers around the print are also open. I found no credited source work beyond Harold Buckley's original story, I did not confirm any licensed-in music, and I did not confirm any restoration. Check any specific copy you use for added titles, music or other new material.
faq: Was the copyright on Sinners in Paradise renewed?

Not confirmed either way. Universal registered it on May 2, 1938, so the renewal window ran from May 1965 to May 1966. I have not completed a full read of the 1965 or 1966 renewal sections of the Catalog of Copyright Entries, so renewal status is undetermined until that read is done.
